Title: Service-aided subnet configuration for managed instance in Azure SQL Database is now available

Body.Content:
To address customer security and manageability requirements, managed instance, a deployment capability of Azure SQL Database, is transitioning from a manual to service-aided subnet configuration.

With the service-aided subnet configuration, you control data traffic while managed instance ensures the uninterrupted flow of management traffic. The configuration also enables improved network security policy.

Learn more about the service-aided subnet configuration.
